seo.statusSummary: Acceptable baseline with actionable improvement areas

findings.title: HTTP Status 200 OK
findings.evidence: Server returned HTTP 200 OK in 59ms
findings.recommendation: Target URL is accessible to search engines.

findings.title: HTTPS Secure Encryption
findings.evidence: Website is served securely over HTTPS protocol (https://example.com/).
findings.recommendation: Maintain active TLS certificates and HSTS.

findings.title: Title Tag Too Short
findings.evidence: Found: "Example Domain" (14 characters). Search engines recommend 30-60 characters.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive keywords to improve CTR.

findings.title: Missing Meta Description
findings.evidence: No <meta name="description"> found in page header.
findings.recommendation: Add a meta description summarizing the page content in 140-160 characters.

findings.title: Missing Canonical Link Element
findings.evidence: No <link rel="canonical"> tag detected in document <head>.
findings.recommendation: Specify canonical URL to protect against duplicate content indexing.

findings.title: Single H1 Heading Configured
findings.evidence: Found 1 primary <h1>: "Example Domain"
findings.recommendation: Maintain single primary topic hierarchy.

findings.title: No Images Detected
findings.evidence: Page contains 0 tags.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding contextual visual assets to increase user engagement.

findings.title: Incomplete Open Graph Tags
findings.evidence: Found 0 Open Graph tags (none).
findings.recommendation: Implement og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url for rich social sharing.

findings.title: robots.txt Not Accessible
findings.evidence: No robots.txt detected at domain root /robots.txt.
findings.recommendation: Deploy a robots.txt file to guide search engine crawlers.

findings.title: XML Sitemap Missing at Root
findings.evidence: Could not locate sitemap.xml at /sitemap.xml.
findings.recommendation: Generate an XML sitemap and reference it inside robots.txt.

findings.title: FAQ & Direct Answer Opportunity
findings.evidence: No formal FAQ block or FAQPage Schema detected on this page.
findings.recommendation: Add an FAQ section with direct question-and-answer pairs matching user query intent.

findings.title: Few Question-Based Headings
findings.evidence: Only 0 question pattern headings found.
findings.recommendation: Adopt conversational question headings (e.g., "What is...", "How to...") to trigger Answer Engine extractions.

findings.title: Unstructured Text Flow for Snippets
findings.evidence: No bulleted lists or tabular data structures found on page.
findings.recommendation: Format core steps, features, or specifications into HTML <ul>/<ol> lists to increase snippet eligibility.

findings.title: Missing Machine-Readable JSON-LD
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD structured data detected. AI scrapers must rely solely on raw text parsing.
findings.recommendation: Inject JSON-LD schemas (WebPage, Organization, Article, or FAQPage) to clarify entities for AI models.

findings.title: Thin Content for AI Context Processing
findings.evidence: Extracted only 17 words of readable body text.
findings.recommendation: Substantially expand page content with detailed explanations and verifiable context.

findings.title: Shallow Heading Hierarchy
findings.evidence: Found 0 H2s and 0 H3s. Flat content structures complicate AI chunking.
findings.recommendation: Structure topics into granular subheadings (H2, H3) to aid AI RAG retrieval systems.

findings.title: Weak Entity Disambiguation
findings.evidence: Limited recognizable named entities found in structured headers.
findings.recommendation: Clarify organization name, parent company, and primary product entities using schema.org/Organization.

findings.title: Missing External Citations or Sources
findings.evidence: Only 1 outbound link(s) detected. Generative engines favor cited assertions.
findings.recommendation: Include citations and links to authoritative source material to validate claims.

findings.title: About Page Link Not Found
findings.evidence: No link containing "about", "about-us", or "team" found in navigation.
findings.recommendation: Provide an accessible About Us page link in the header or footer.

findings.title: Author Attribution Not Found
findings.evidence: No explicit author byline, biographical snippet, or Person schema detected.
findings.recommendation: Add author bylines with professional credentials, degrees, or verified experience.

findings.title: Contact Information Not Found
findings.evidence: No visible email address, phone number, or Contact Us link detected.
findings.recommendation: Provide clear, verifiable contact channels (email, phone, physical location) to foster user trust.

findings.title: Privacy Policy Link Not Found
findings.evidence: No hyperlink matching privacy policy keywords found.
findings.recommendation: Publish and link a legally compliant Privacy Policy in the global footer.

findings.title: Terms of Service Not Found
findings.evidence: No Terms of Service link found on the audited page.
findings.recommendation: Add clear Terms of Service to clarify user agreements and operational disclosures.

findings.title: Missing Core Security Headers
findings.evidence: Missing one or more trust headers (HSTS: false, X-Content-Type-Options: false, CSP: false).
findings.recommendation: Configure HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and CSP to demonstrate technical integrity.
